(c) The amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the card tier's maximum: Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards, Crypto-Cash Back) $2500.00; Mid Tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $5000.00; Premium Tier (Gold Rewards, Business Gold Rewards) $10000.00; Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards, Business Platinum Rewards) $15000.00; Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite) $25000.00.
